verdicts.reason: The two leaderboards are effectively identical: '20% off' sits on the left, the three-line body copy next to it, the product in a peach circle, and the Shop Sale button on the right. Both share the same flaws. The body copy is set almost as large as the headline, so the two compete for attention. The can is shrunk to a tiny graphic, its label unreadable and its circle sitting on the bottom edge. 'WEEKEND ONLY' is jammed against the top edge, and the 'Ends Sunday' legal line is too small to read at this size.
